title: Products of ringed pro-etale open extensions without ambient quasi-compactness
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with restricted coefficient ring $R|_U$, via the slice identification [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization]. Let $j_!$ be sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the extension-by-zero module presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. For every family $(F_s)_{s\in S}$ of $R|_U$-module sheaves indexed by a set small in the fixed module universe, the canonical map
$$j_!\left(\prod_{s\in S}F_s\right)\longrightarrow\prod_{s\in S}j_!F_s,$$
whose $s$-th component is $j_!$ applied to the $s$-th projection, is an isomorphism of $R$-module sheaves, natural in maps of families. Products are the sectionwise limits of [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise]. The empty family is included. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness of $X$ is assumed.
